turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so you have twenty-five minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start with that.
I'll stand until I hear why nobody called me before that mark went in. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. This is exactly the battle worth picking, and if the zero stands, I'm in the principal's office before I leave this building.
